provider_receipt.summary: Review found named correctness and security defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store only serializes a MemoryRecord and discards it, so the claimed persistent-memory integration performs no storage; (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 expects legacy fields and numeric confidence, making it incompatible with the documented human_knowledge.v1 frontmatter at docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94; (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits absolute and parent-relative wikilinks to resolve outside the vault boundary; (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently drops traversal errors, allowing incomplete scans to report success; and (5) src/lib.rs:94-98 accepts any existing path, including a regular file, as a vault. The parent receipt authenticates README inspection and a clean-tree check only; it provides no implementation or test evidence supporting correctness. No files were modified and declared checks were not rerun.
